## Change

Explain the behavior and reason for the change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] README/SECURITY/docs describe the current behavior, or a changelog entry records why no guide changes are needed.
- [ ] `npm run docs:generate` output is committed when routes, configuration, navigation or commands change.
- [ ] UI changes include a browser check, including the affected mobile/keyboard flow.
- [ ] Screenshots and fixtures contain fictional data; no deployment secrets or personal records are included.
